reference_sql:
SELECT p.product_name, c.parent_category
FROM products p
JOIN categories c ON c.category_id = p.category_id
WHERE p.brand = 'Vistara'
alternatives: SELECT products.product_name, categories.parent_category FROM categories JOIN products ON products.category_id = categories.category_id WHERE products.brand = 'Vistara'
SELECT p.product_name, c.parent_category FROM products p, categories c WHERE c.category_id = p.category_id AND p.brand = 'Vistara'
SELECT p.product_name, c.parent_category FROM products AS p INNER JOIN categories AS c USING (category_id) WHERE p.brand = 'Vistara'

other_way.sql: SELECT p.product_name, c.parent_category FROM products p, categories c WHERE c.category_id = p.category_id AND p.brand = 'Vistara'
other_way.tradeoff: Listing the tables with a comma and matching in WHERE also works, but a forgotten match then pairs every row.
